newsitem.title: THAILAND: Fuji Heavy Industries, Marubeni in Thai venture.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Heavy Industries, Marubeni in Thai venture.

text.p: Thai automotive conglomerate KPN Group said on Wednesday it, Fuji Heavy Industries Co Ltd and Marubeni Corp had reached an agreement to set up a joint venture in Thailand.
The joint venture, Subaru (Thailand) Co Ltd, would be responsible for the distribution and marketing of Subaru brand cars in Thailand, KPN Group said in a statement.
Fuji heavy Industries holds a 42 percent stake in Subaru (Thailand), while KPN Group and Marubeni together with its Thai unit have 25 and 33 percent respectively, it said.
Subaru (Thailand) expects its sales of Subaru cars to reach 1,000 units in 1997 and 1,500 in 1998.
The Subaru car sold in Thailand will be wholly imported, KPN Group said.
Subaru (Thailand) has no plans to set up an assembly plant in the near term because sales remained low, it added.
